Name: Barn Animals' Double Shadows Fix
Author: Nekotekina
Description:
Currently, a bug causes barn animals to have their ordinary shadows and a smaller intrusive shadow on top of it, as seen in the images, due to recent updates in the game's code. This mod fixes the issue.
[color=#ffff00]
[b]This does not change the appearance of the animals, it only fixes the shadows. It is therefore compatible with any mod that changes their appearance.[/b][/color]

[b]Special note:[/b] 90% of users who download my mods forget to endorse them. If you like this mod, consider endorsing it! It shows appreciation for our efforts and greatly helps me by allowing more people to see it.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/WzQQc1T/ENDORSE.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher;
2. Download this mod & extract [CP] Barn Animals' Double Shadows Fix folder to Stardew Valley/Mods;
3. Run the game with SMAPI to play.
